_help: Your projects, in the order to show them. Add the GitHub link of each repo to "repos" and push: the sync reads each README and fills data/projects.json (title, what it does, the problem, features, tech, live site, screenshots and demo video). It runs when this file changes and once a day. Public repos just work. Private repos need the PROJECTS_TOKEN secret (see documentation.md), and their README text and media become public here. To change something the README gets wrong, use an object instead of a link, like { "repo": "https://github.com/you/app", "blurb": "Your own words" }.
